findings.authoredCue: S09-S11 office briefing requires Matteo's keys and closed red-tabbed folder to remain visible while the dialogue references the staffing crisis and work materials.
findings.observation: Current 1024x1536 portrait source places the keys and closed folder in the lower table band; current 360x640, 390x844 and 430x932 runtime frames put them under the dialogue-safe overlay.
findings.playerImpact: The authored objects cannot be recognized at the moment the dialogue relies on them.
